rationale: Option B remaps issue_num, not the issue_id string primary key that is the actual cross-repo collision surface for several downstream keying sites, and risks breaking the on-disk supersedes: join; Option A extends the pervasive tuple-key-widening idiom already used in agent_quality.py/rework.py and has direct precedent in repo_path.name as a per-member label.
rule: Option A — Repo discriminator threaded through every keying site
alternatives_rejected: Option B: issue_num remapping in the union views
